book.name: Filimon
book.title: FILIMON PITA PƗLƗWUKNA TATA LƗGA PAS

content: Wun Pol wun. Wan pas wunayɨ pɨlɨwukna. Wun Kraist Jisasna njɨvwa kwutɨwun maa wun kat kwutaa kalabusmba taagandi. Kalabusmbalɨga kan pas mɨn kat pɨlɨwukowun. Timoti nɨna kɨta mbaapmamba lɨga nyana. Wunogwinala lɨgandɨ. Filimon mɨn kat kan pas pɨlɨwupmat yigowun. Mɨn nɨnogwinala kɨta njɨvwamba lɨga nyan mɨn. Mɨn kat woviyaguga lɨgowun.

Mɨna taagwa kat Apia kat pɨlɨwukowun. Lɨ nɨnagwi kɨta mbaapmamba lɨgat taagwat. Mɨna nyan Akipas ndɨno ndɨ kat pɨlɨwukwun. Tat nɨnogwinala Godna njɨvwa kwutɨndɨ. Ndɨ soldia vla lɨga kan njɨvwa kwutɨndɨ. Mɨnagwinala mɨna ngaymba yisola lɨga Godna mbaapma nɨmba ndino ndi kat kan pas pɨlɨwukwun.
Nɨna nyaek Godno nɨna nyamwun Jisas Kraistno awagapma nɨn kat kwilɨmba apma vat klangwangat ngwuk kat wowun.
FILIMON GOD KAT NƗMA VAT NDƗNA MAAWUPMBA YELAVƗKA LƗNDƗ

Mɨn njambwi nyan Jisas kat nɨma maawut yelavɨka lɨmɨn. Wutwun. Godna mbaapmamba lɨga nɨmba kat woviyaguga kwunatɨgamɨn. Wutwun. Ngi kat tɨga God kat waweya njɨmbla mɨn kat yelavɨka God kat mbukiyowun ndɨ apma nyana waa mbukiyowun.
Mɨn God kat mɨna maawupmba yelavɨka lɨga vak nat nɨmba kat mbutɨgamɨn. Ndi wutaa Kraist nɨn kat apma vat yinda vat klambandi walaa ndi kat wowun.
Godna mbaapmamba lɨga nɨmba kat woviyaguga lɨga ndi kat kwunatɨgamɨn. Wutwun. Wutaa mɨn kat solat sɨga yelavɨka lɨwun.
POL FILIMON KAT WAGALAVAT TƗNDƗ
Wun Kraistna njɨvwa kwutɨga nɨmbana nɨma nyan wun. Mɨn kat nɨmamba waweyan apma vatna. Wun njambwi nyan wun. Waweya vak wukiyamɨn.

Mɨn kat wupma ana waigowun. Mɨn kat kwo wagalaveigowun. Wun Kraist Jisasna njɨvwa kwutɨwun, wun kat kalabusmba taagandi. Wun avɨt ndu wun. Njambwi nyan vla lɨga ana nɨma kwundimba mɨn kat wagalagiyowun. Kwo nyan vla lɨga mɨn kat wagalagiyowun.
Wuna nyan vla lɨga nyan kat tɨga mɨn kat wagalagiyowun. Ndɨna sɨ Onisimas. Kalabusmba lɨga ndɨ kat Godna nyaangɨt mbukwun, wutaa Godna mbaapma wuleindɨ. Ngi kat tɨga Onisimas wuna nyan vla lɨgandɨ.
Tamba mɨna njɨvwa apma vat ana kwutɨndɨ. Kavle njɨvwa kwuka yetɨndɨ. Mbambala wonogwinala tɨga wuna njɨvwa apma vat kwutɨgandɨ. Ngɨni mɨnai lɨga kava yilaa mɨna njɨvwa apma vat kwukiyandɨ.
Wowun maa mɨnai lɨga kavat yaigandɨ. Ndɨ kat nɨma vat yelavɨka solat sɨga lɨgowun. Apma njɨvwa kwutɨgandɨ.
Wunogwinala tɨgendan apma vatna. Kalabusmba luwa njɨmbla wun kat apma vat kwukendɨ. Mɨn sɨvlamba lɨgamɨn. Mɨn wun kat kwunapmak kwukemɨn njɨvwa vla ndɨ ngwaymba lɨga wun kat kwunakendɨ.

Ndɨ kat lungwamataa ay mɨla waa kwo ana waigowun. Tak mɨn kat wagalalaa ay mɨla waa kwo ana waigowun. Tak mɨn kat wagalalaa ndɨ kat waigowun. Wunai waiga vapmba ndɨ kat apma vat yivak kat kai wowun. Mɨnai yelavɨka lɨga vapmba ndɨ kat apma vat yigiyamɨn. Vɨga lɨgowun.
Tat mɨn kat kwagalalaa yindɨ. Wan nɨma vat ana ndɨ. Samat tɨga lungwamata yiga mɨnogwinala njɨmbla njɨmbla tɨgiyandɨ. Wan nɨma vatna.

Tak mɨna njɨvwa kwuta nyanat tɨndɨ. Ngɨni mɨna mbaapma nyanat tɨga mɨna njɨvwa kwukiyandɨ. Ndɨ kat vɨlaa solaat sɨgiyamɨn. Ndɨ mbaapma wuleindɨ, ndɨ kat solat sɨga lɨwun. Mɨno ndɨ kat solat sɨgiyamɨn. Mɨna kɨta mbaapma nyanat tɨga mɨna njɨvwa kwukiyandɨ. Mɨn ndɨ kat nɨmamba woviyaguga solat sɨgiyamɨn.
Mɨnai lɨga kava yandɨ maa ndɨ kat yagwa waa awambamɨn. Mɨn wunkɨta njɨvwa kwutɨga nyan li. Mɨnai lɨga kava yandɨ maa wun kat yagwa wama vla ndɨ kat yagwa awamba.
Mɨn kɨta nda sikwutan wuna lak mɨn kat wenga kwigiyowun. Mɨn kat kavle vat yindan wuna lak mɨn kat kwunakiyowun.
Kan nyaangɨt wuna taamba pɨlɨwuka mɨn kat kwigowun. Wuna lak mɨn kat kwigiyowun waa mɨn kat pɨlɨwukowun. Mɨn awat wun kat apma vat ana yimɨn. yilapman yima vak kat ana waigowun.
Mɨn njambwi nyana kɨta mbaapma nyanmɨn. Awat wun kat apma vat yigiyamɨn. Apma vat yimɨn maa wuna maawut apma vat tɨgiyandɨ.
Mɨn kat wagalawa nyaangɨt wutaa apma vat yigiyamɨn. Vɨga lɨgowun. Wagalawa vak wutaa apma njɨvwa kwuka kaligiyamɨn.
Njɨvwa kwuka lɨga mɨna ngaymba sɨndu kwaweya kava wun kat kwunap mɨla. God kat wagalamɨn mala mɨnai lɨga kava givat wowun.
NGƗNI LA LƗGA NYAANGƗT
Epafras mɨn kat apma nandinya walɨgandɨ. Ndɨnogwi Kraist Jisasna njɨvwa kwutɨndɨ maa ndɨ kat kalabusmba taagandi.
Wunogwinala kɨta vat njɨvwa kwutɨga nɨmba Mak, Aristakas, Dimas, Luk, ndi aywaa mɨn kat apma nandinya walɨgandi.
Nɨna njambwi nyan Jisas Kraist kwiya apma vat klambamɨn walaa mɨn kat wowun. Wan apma vat klameyan mɨna maawut apma vat tɨgiyandɨ. Ngiyambak.
